sources.title: K2-Horizon-7B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview K2-Horizon-7B-GGUF is a GGUF distribution of IFM's K2-Horizon-7B, a 7B-core dense, decoder-only text-generation model with a native 524,288-token context window. It targets reasoning, mathematics, software engineering, scientific coding, long-context analysis, web browsing, and tool-using agents.
